ideal: Alert: Meta rose 6.55% while the S&P 500 fell 0.46%, and no filing explains it yet. Amazon filed an 8-K (current-events report) under item 5.02, which covers changes to directors or officers, with the link. The Microsoft proxy filing should be left out.

verdicts.note: Covers both events accurately, explains what an 8-K and item 5.02 are in plain words, and leaves out the proxy filing.
verdicts.answer:
Meta Platforms rose 6.55% while the S&P 500 fell 0.46%. No filing explains it yet.
Amazon filed an 8-K, a report on current events. It's under item 5.02, which covers changes to its directors or top officers or their pay: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000101872426000036/amzn-20260908.htm

verdicts.note: Accurate, but it doesn't explain what an 8-K is or what this one is about, so it never says why it matters.
verdicts.answer:
Meta Platforms rose 6.55%, S&P fell 0.46% – no filing explains it yet  
Amazon filed an 8‑K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000101872426000036/amzn-20260908.htm)

verdicts.note: Covers both events, but it crams them into one line, uses the ticker, doesn't call the 8-K a current-events report, and adds 'or similar event', which is a bit loose.
verdicts.answer: META rose 6.55% while the S&P 500 fell 0.46% — no filing explains it yet. Amazon filed an 8-K (item 5.02, departure of officers/directors or similar event) [link](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000101872426000036/amzn-20260908.htm).

verdicts.note: Accurate and calls the 8-K a current-events report, but it doesn't say the filing concerns directors or officers.

Amazon filed 8-K current-events report: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000101872426000036/amzn-20260908.htm

verdicts.note: Complete, plain and accurate, explaining both the kind of filing and what it is about.
verdicts.answer:
